description.sk: Sladko-pikantné kura s chrumkavými arašidmi, rýchlejšie ako donáška.
description.en: Sweet and spicy chicken with crunchy peanuts, faster than takeaway.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 375 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 375 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Kuracie stehná nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm a v miske ich premiešaj s 1 lyžicou sójovej omáčky a polovicou škrobu – škrob vytvorí tenký obal, vďaka ktorému mäso zostane šťavnaté. Nechaj postáť, kým pripravíš ostatné.
steps.en: Cut the chicken thighs into roughly 2 cm cubes and toss them in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and half the cornflour – the cornflour forms a thin coating that keeps the chicken juicy. Leave while you prepare the rest.

steps.sk: Papriku nakrájaj na kúsky asi 2 cm, cesnak nasekaj, zázvor ošúp a nastrúhaj a cibuľku nakrájaj na kúsky, bielu a zelenú časť oddeľ. Omáčka: v pohári zmiešaj zvyšnú sójovú omáčku, ocot, cukor, zvyšný škrob a 4 lyžice vody.
steps.en: Cut the pepper into roughly 2 cm pieces, chop the garlic, peel and grate the ginger and cut the spring onions into lengths, keeping the white and green parts apart. Sauce: in a jar mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, remaining cornflour and 4 tablespoons of water.

steps.sk: Arašidy opraž vo woku alebo veľkej panvici nasucho na strednom ohni 2 až 3 minúty dozlatista a odlož ich. Potom wok rozpáľ s olejom na vysokom ohni a mäso opekaj 5 až 6 minút, kým nie je dozlatista a prepečené, bez ružovej farby vnútri.
steps.en: Toast the peanuts in a dry wok or large frying pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and set them aside. Then heat the oil in the wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, with no pink inside.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, čili, papriku a bielu časť cibuľky a za stáleho miešania opekaj 2 minúty, kým paprika nezačne mäknúť, ale zostane chrumkavá. Čili vločky nenechaj spáliť – stačí, keď zavoňajú.
steps.en: Add the garlic, ginger, chilli, pepper and the white parts of the spring onions and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the pepper starts to soften but stays crisp. Do not let the chilli flakes burn – they only need to smell fragrant.

steps.sk: Omáčku v pohári premiešaj (škrob sa usadí na dne) a vlej do woku. Miešaj asi 30 sekúnd, kým nezhustne a mäso sa nezačne lesknúť. Vmiešaj arašidy a zelenú časť cibuľky a podávaj hneď s ryžou, kým sú arašidy chrumkavé.
steps.en: Stir the sauce in the jar (the cornflour settles at the bottom) and pour it into the wok. Stir for about 30 seconds until it thickens and the chicken turns glossy. Toss in the peanuts and the green spring onions and serve at once with the rice while the peanuts are crunchy.

title.sk: Vyprážaná ryža s vajcom a zeleninou

description.sk: Najlepší spôsob, ako zúžitkovať včerajšiu ryžu.
description.en: The best way to use up yesterday's rice.

note.sk: suchá váha; uvarená deň vopred a vychladená
note.en: dry weight; cooked the day before and chilled

steps.sk: Studenú ryžu z chladničky rozober prstami, aby sa rozpadli hrudky – čerstvo uvarená by sa zlepila na kašu, preto ju uvar deň vopred. Cesnak nasekaj, cibuľku nakrájaj na kolieska a vajcia rozšľahaj.
steps.en: Break up the cold rice from the fridge with your fingers to separate any clumps – freshly cooked rice turns mushy, so cook it the day before. Chop the garlic, slice the spring onions and beat the eggs.

steps.sk: Vo woku alebo veľkej panvici rozpáľ polovicu oleja na vysokom ohni, vlej vajcia a stierkou ich rýchlo zamiešaj na mäkkú praženicu – trvá to asi 30 sekúnd. Odlož ich na tanier, ešte trochu dotiahnu.
steps.en: Heat half the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat, pour in the eggs and quickly scramble them softly with a spatula – it takes about 30 seconds. Tip them onto a plate; they will finish setting there.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj cesnak asi 20 sekúnd, kým nezavonia, pridaj mrazenú zeleninu (netreba ju rozmrazovať) a opekaj 3 minúty, kým sa neodparí voda a zelenina sa neprehreje.
steps.en: Fry the garlic in the remaining oil for about 20 seconds until fragrant, add the frozen vegetables (no need to thaw) and cook for 3 minutes until the water has evaporated and they are hot.

steps.sk: Pridaj ryžu, varechou rozbi zvyšné hrudky a opekaj na prudkom ohni 4 minúty; ryžu vždy chvíľu nechaj ležať, aby sa opiekla, a potom premiešaj. Zrnká majú byť horúce, oddelené a miestami chrumkavé.
steps.en: Add the rice, break up any remaining lumps with a spoon and fry over high heat for 4 minutes, letting it sit for a moment between stirs so it toasts. The grains should be hot, separate and crisp in places.

steps.sk: Sójovú omáčku vlej po okraji panvice, nech zasyčí, a vmiešaj vajcia, sezamový olej a cibuľku. Premiešaj, ochutnaj a podávaj hneď.
steps.en: Pour the soy sauce around the edge of the pan so it sizzles, then stir in the eggs, sesame oil and spring onions. Toss, taste and serve at once.

title.sk: Pikantné tofu so sezamom a ryžou
title.en: Spicy tofu with sesame and rice

description.sk: Rastlinná obdoba mapo tofu: jemné tofu v pálivej omáčke s ryžou.
description.en: A plant-based take on mapo tofu: soft tofu in a fiery sauce with rice.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 340 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 340 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Tofu sceď, opatrne ho osuš a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm. Ak máš čas, zalej ho na 5 minút horúcou vodou – spevní sa a pri varení sa nerozpadne. Cesnak nasekaj, zázvor nastrúhaj a cibuľku nakrájaj, bielu a zelenú časť oddeľ.
steps.en: Drain the tofu, pat it dry carefully and cut it into roughly 2 cm cubes. If you have time, soak it in hot water for 5 minutes – it firms up and does not break while cooking. Chop the garlic, grate the ginger and slice the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts apart.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cesnak, zázvor, bielu časť cibuľky a čili vločky opekaj asi minútu, kým nezavoňajú – nenechaj ich zhnednúť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and cook the garlic, ginger, white spring onions and chilli flakes for about a minute until fragrant – do not let them brown.

steps.sk: Prilej 200 ml vody, sójovú a hoisin omáčku a priveď do varu. Opatrne pridaj tofu a jemne var 5 minút, aby nasalo chuť. Nemiešaj, len panvicou občas zatras alebo kocky potlač lyžicou, aby sa nerozpadli.
steps.en: Pour in 200 ml of water, the soy sauce and hoisin and bring to the boil. Gently add the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes so it absorbs the flavour. Do not stir – just shake the pan now and then or nudge the cubes with a spoon so they stay whole.

steps.sk: Škrob rozmiešaj v 2 lyžiciach studenej vody, vlej do omáčky a opatrne miešaj asi 30 sekúnd, kým omáčka nezhustne a nezačne sa lesknúť.
steps.en: Mix the cornflour with 2 tablespoons of cold water, pour it into the sauce and stir gently for about 30 seconds until it thickens and turns glossy.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj sezamovým olejom, posyp zelenou cibuľkou a sezamom a podávaj s ryžou. Zvyšok vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Drizzle with the sesame oil, sprinkle with the green spring onions and sesame seeds and serve with the rice. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Teriyaki losos s brokolicou a ryžou
title.en: Teriyaki salmon with broccoli and rice

description.sk: Lesklá domáca teriyaki omáčka, šťavnatý losos a brokolica na pare.
description.en: A glossy homemade teriyaki sauce, juicy salmon and steamed broccoli.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 375 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 375 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Brokolicu rozober na ružičky a hrubšiu stonku ošúp a nakrájaj. Var ju na pare alebo v hrnci s 2 cm vody pod pokrievkou 4 minúty, kým nie je jasne zelená a jemne chrumkavá, potom ju sceď.
steps.en: Cut the broccoli into florets; peel and slice the thick stalk. Steam it, or cook it covered in a pan with 2 cm of water, for 4 minutes until bright green and still slightly crisp, then drain.

steps.sk: Omáčka: v miske zmiešaj sójovú omáčku, med, ocot, nastrúhaný zázvor a pretlačený cesnak, kým sa med nerozpustí. Lososa nakrájaj na 4 porcie a dôkladne osuš papierovou utierkou – suchý sa lepšie opečie a neprilepí sa.
steps.en: Sauce: stir the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, grated ginger and crushed garlic together in a small bowl until the honey dissolves. Cut the salmon into 4 portions and pat them thoroughly dry with kitchen paper – dry fish browns better and does not stick.

steps.sk: V nepriľnavej panvici rozohrej olej na stredne vysokom ohni a lososa polož kožou nadol (ak ju má). Opekaj 4 minúty bez hýbania, kým koža nie je chrumkavá a ryba je do dvoch tretín výšky nepriehľadná. Potom ho opatrne obráť a opekaj ešte 2 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and lay the salmon in skin side down (if it has skin). Cook for 4 minutes without moving it until the skin is crisp and the fish is opaque two-thirds of the way up. Then turn it carefully and cook for 2 minutes more.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň na stredný, vlej omáčku a 1 až 2 minúty ňou lososa polievaj, kým nezhustne do lesklej glazúry – med sa rýchlo pripáli, preto ju nevar dlho. Losos je hotový, keď sa v strede ľahko rozdeľuje na lupienky a je ešte šťavnatý (52–55 °C).
steps.en: Lower the heat to medium, pour in the sauce and spoon it over the salmon for 1 to 2 minutes until it thickens into a glossy glaze – honey burns quickly, so do not cook it long. The salmon is done when it flakes easily in the centre and is still juicy (52–55 °C).

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a brokolicou, polej zvyšnou glazúrou z panvice a posyp sezamom.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and broccoli, spoon over the rest of the glaze from the pan and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

description.sk: Ľahká a hrejivá polievka za 15 minút.
description.en: A light, warming soup in 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Šampiňóny očisti a nakrájaj na tenké plátky, tofu sceď a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1 cm, nori nastrihaj nožnicami na tenké prúžky a cibuľku nakrájaj na tenké kolieska.
steps.en: Clean and thinly slice the mushrooms, drain the tofu and cut it into roughly 1 cm cubes, snip the nori into thin strips with scissors and slice the spring onions thinly.

steps.sk: V hrnci priveď 700 ml vody takmer do varu, pridaj huby a mierne var 3 minúty, kým nezmäknú.
steps.en: Bring 700 ml of water almost to the boil in a pan, add the mushrooms and simmer gently for 3 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj tofu a nori a nechaj ich asi minútu prehriať. Tofu je krehké, preto už polievku nemiešaj prudko.
steps.en: Add the tofu and nori and let them heat through for about a minute. Tofu is delicate, so do not stir the soup vigorously from now on.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav z ohňa. Miso daj do naberačky, ponor ju do polievky a lyžicou ho v nej rozmiešaj, kým sa úplne nerozpustí, potom ho vmiešaj do hrnca. Polievku už nevar – varom by miso stratilo vôňu a chuť.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat. Put the miso in a ladle, dip it into the soup and stir with a spoon until it dissolves completely, then stir it into the pan. Do not boil the soup again – boiling destroys the aroma and flavour of the miso.

steps.sk: Nalej do misiek, posyp jarnou cibuľkou a podávaj hneď. Pri ohrievaní zvyšku dbaj, aby polievka nezovrela.
steps.en: Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with the spring onions and serve at once. When reheating leftovers, do not let the soup boil.

description.sk: Farebná kórejská miska: ryža, zelenina, pikantné hovädzie a volské oko.
description.en: A colourful Korean bowl: rice, vegetables, spicy beef and a fried egg.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 340 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 340 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Mrkvu ošúp a spolu s cuketou nakrájaj na tenké prúžky ako zápalky. Cesnak nasekaj. Omáčku na pokvapkanie priprav vopred: zmiešaj 1 lyžicu gočudžangu, 1 lyžicu sójovej omáčky a sezamový olej.
steps.en: Peel the carrots and cut them and the courgette into thin matchsticks. Chop the garlic. Make the drizzling sauce now: mix 1 tablespoon of the gochujang, 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and the sesame oil.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej panvici zohrej trochu oleja na strednom ohni a mrkvu opekaj 2 až 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne, ale zostane jasne oranžová. Odlož ju a rovnako opeč cuketu. Nakoniec daj do panvice špenát a miešaj asi minútu, kým nezvädne. Keď opečieš každú zeleninu zvlášť, zachová si farbu aj chuť.
steps.en: Heat a little oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the carrots for 2 to 3 minutes until tender but still bright orange. Set them aside and cook the courgette the same way. Finally add the spinach and stir for about a minute until wilted. Cooking each vegetable separately keeps its colour and flavour.

steps.sk: V tej istej panvici opekaj mäso s cesnakom na vyššom ohni asi 6 minút; varechou ho rozbíjaj, kým nie je bez ružovej farby. Pridaj 2 lyžice sójovej omáčky, cukor a 1 lyžicu gočudžangu a minútu povar, kým sa omáčka neodparí.
steps.en: In the same pan fry the beef with the garlic over higher heat for about 6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains. Add 2 tablespoons of the soy sauce, the sugar and 1 tablespoon of the gochujang and cook for a minute until the sauce has evaporated.

steps.sk: Panvicu utri, rozohrej v nej zvyšný olej na strednom ohni a usmaž 3 volské oká – asi 3 minúty, kým bielok nie je stuhnutý a žĺtok zostane tekutý.
steps.en: Wipe out the pan, heat the remaining oil over medium heat and fry 3 eggs sunny side up for about 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.

steps.sk: Do misiek daj ryžu, navrch vedľa seba poukladaj mrkvu, cuketu, špenát a mäso a do stredu polož vajce. Pokvapkaj pripravenou omáčkou a posyp sezamom. Pri stole všetko premiešaj – tekutý žĺtok obalí ryžu.
steps.en: Put the rice in bowls, arrange the carrots, courgette, spinach and beef side by side on top and place an egg in the middle. Drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Mix everything together at the table – the runny yolk coats the rice.

description.sk: Pikantná a kyslastá ryža z pár surovín, s vajíčkom navrchu.
description.en: Spicy, tangy rice from a few ingredients, topped with an egg.

note.sk: suchá váha; uvarená deň vopred a vychladená
note.en: dry weight; cooked the day before and chilled

steps.sk: Studenú ryžu z chladničky rozober prstami na jednotlivé zrnká. Kimči nakrájaj nadrobno a odlož si 2 lyžice jeho šťavy – dodá ryži farbu a chuť. Cibuľku nakrájaj na kolieska a nori nastrihaj na prúžky.
steps.en: Break the cold rice from the fridge into separate grains with your fingers. Finely chop the kimchi and keep 2 tablespoons of its juice – it gives the rice colour and flavour. Slice the spring onions and snip the nori into strips.

steps.sk: Vo woku alebo veľkej panvici zohrej väčšinu oleja na strednom ohni a kimči opekaj 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne a nezačne karamelizovať.
steps.en: Heat most of the oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat and fry the kimchi for 3 minutes until soft and starting to caramelise.

steps.sk: Zvýš oheň, pridaj ryžu, gočudžang, sójovú omáčku a šťavu z kimči a opekaj 4 minúty za častého miešania, kým ryža nie je rovnomerne červená, horúca a miestami chrumkavá.
steps.en: Turn up the heat, add the rice, gochujang, soy sauce and kimchi juice and fry for 4 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is evenly red, piping hot and crisp in places.

steps.sk: Medzitým na inej panvici na zvyšnom oleji usmaž 2 volské oká, asi 3 minúty, kým bielok nie je stuhnutý a žĺtok tekutý.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry 2 eggs sunny side up in the remaining oil in another pan for about 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks runny.

steps.sk: Ryžu odstav, pokvapkaj sezamovým olejom a premiešaj. Rozdeľ ju do misiek, posyp cibuľkou a nori a navrch polož vajce. Jedz hneď.
steps.en: Take the rice off the heat, drizzle with the sesame oil and toss. Divide between bowls, sprinkle with the spring onions and nori and top each with an egg. Eat at once.

title.sk: Hovädzie s brokolicou na čínsky spôsob

description.sk: Tenké plátky hovädzieho v lesklej omáčke s brokolicou a ryžou.
description.en: Thin slices of beef in a glossy sauce with broccoli and rice.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 340 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 340 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj naprieč vláknami na tenké plátky asi 3 mm – krátke vlákna znamenajú mäkké mäso. Premiešaj ho s 1 lyžicou sójovej omáčky a polovicou škrobu a nechaj 10 minút postáť.
steps.en: Slice the beef across the grain into thin slices about 3 mm – short fibres mean tender meat. Toss it with 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and half the cornflour and leave for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Brokolicu rozober na menšie ružičky a var ju vo vriacej vode 2 minúty, potom ju sceď a prepláchni studenou vodou – zostane jasne zelená a vo woku sa len dohreje.
steps.en: Cut the broccoli into small florets and cook them in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water – they stay bright green and only need reheating in the wok.

steps.sk: Omáčka: v pohári zmiešaj zvyšnú sójovú omáčku, ustricovú omáčku, cukor, zvyšný škrob a 100 ml vody. Cesnak nasekaj a zázvor nastrúhaj.
steps.en: Sauce: in a jar mix the remaining soy sauce, the oyster sauce, sugar, remaining cornflour and 100 ml of water. Chop the garlic and grate the ginger.

steps.sk: Wok alebo veľkú panvicu rozpáľ s väčšinou oleja na vysokom ohni, kým nezačne dymiť. Mäso opekaj v dvoch dávkach po 2 minúty, kým nezhnedne – prvú minútu ním nehýb. Hotové odlož na tanier; vnútri môže byť ešte jemne ružové, dovarí sa v omáčke.
steps.en: Heat most of the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until smoking. Sear the beef in two batches for 2 minutes each until browned – leave it untouched for the first minute. Set it aside on a plate; it can still be slightly pink inside, as it finishes in the sauce.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji asi 20 sekúnd opeč cesnak a zázvor. Omáčku premiešaj, vlej ju do woku a za stáleho miešania nechaj asi minútu zhustnúť. Vráť mäso aj brokolicu a premiešaj, kým sa všetko neobalí lesklou omáčkou. Podávaj hneď s ryžou.
steps.en: Fry the garlic and ginger in the remaining oil for about 20 seconds. Stir the sauce, pour it into the wok and stir for about a minute until thickened. Return the beef and broccoli and toss until coated in the glossy sauce. Serve at once with the rice.

title.en: Sweet and sour chicken with pineapple

description.sk: Domáca verzia obľúbeného jedla z bistra, bez fritovania.
description.en: A homemade version of the takeaway favourite, without deep frying.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 450 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 450 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia nakrájaj na kocky asi 2,5 cm a v miske ich obaľ v polovici škrobu, kým nie sú všetky pokryté tenkou vrstvou. Papriku a cibuľu nakrájaj na kúsky asi 2,5 cm a ananás na kúsky podobnej veľkosti.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into roughly 2.5 cm cubes and toss them in a bowl with half the cornflour until thinly coated. Cut the peppers and onion into roughly 2.5 cm pieces and the pineapple into chunks of a similar size.

steps.sk: Omáčka: v pohári zmiešaj kečup, ocot, cukor, sójovú omáčku, zvyšný škrob a 150 ml vody, kým sa škrob nerozpustí.
steps.en: Sauce: in a jar mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, remaining cornflour and 150 ml of water until the cornflour dissolves.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici alebo woku rozohrej väčšinu oleja na stredne vysokom ohni a mäso opekaj 5 až 6 minút, obracaj ho, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatisté a vnútri biele. Odlož ho na tanier.
steps.en: Heat most of the oil in a wide frying pan or wok over medium-high heat and fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, turning it, until golden on all sides and white inside. Set it aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj papriku a cibuľu 3 minúty na vysokom ohni, aby zostali chrumkavé. Pridaj ananás, omáčku premiešaj a vlej do panvice; za stáleho miešania ju asi minútu povar, kým nezhustne a nie je priesvitná a lesklá.
steps.en: Stir-fry the peppers and onion in the remaining oil over high heat for 3 minutes so they stay crisp. Add the pineapple, stir the sauce and pour it in; cook, stirring, for about a minute until thick, translucent and glossy.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso, premiešaj, aby sa obalilo v omáčke, a podávaj hneď s ryžou. Zvyšok vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Return the chicken, toss to coat it in the sauce and serve at once with the rice. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

description.sk: Jemné, husté a sladkasté kari, ktoré majú radi aj deti.
description.en: A mild, thick and slightly sweet curry that children love too.

steps.sk: Kuracie stehná nakrájaj na kúsky asi 3 cm a cibule na mesiačiky. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm a mrkvu na kúsky asi 2 cm – je tvrdšia, preto menšie.
steps.en: Cut the chicken thighs into roughly 3 cm pieces and the onions into wedges. Peel the potatoes and cut them into roughly 3 cm cubes, and the carrots into 2 cm chunks – they are harder, so smaller.

steps.sk: Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej olej na stredne vysokom ohni a mäso s cibuľou opekaj asi 6 minút, kým mäso nie je zo všetkých strán svetlo opečené a cibuľa nezmäkne.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken with the onions for about 6 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned all over and the onions soften.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky, mrkvu, rozdrobený bujón a 700 ml vody, priveď do varu a z povrchu zober penu. Zníž oheň a mierne var 20 minút, kým zelenina nie je mäkká.
steps.en: Add the potatoes, carrots, crumbled stock cube and 700 ml of water, bring to the boil and skim off any foam. Lower the heat and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

steps.sk: Medzitým ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 450 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 450 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Kari základ: v malom hrnci roztop maslo na miernom ohni, vsyp múku a za stáleho miešania ju praž 2 minúty, kým nie je svetlohnedá a nevonia orieškovo. Vmiešaj karí korenie a minútu ho opekaj – zmes bude hustá a drobivá.
steps.en: Curry roux: melt the butter in a small pan over low heat, add the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes until light brown and nutty-smelling. Stir in the curry powder and cook for a minute – the mixture will be thick and crumbly.

steps.sk: Základ rozmiešaj v naberačke horúceho vývaru do hladka, aby nevznikli hrudky, a vlej do hrnca. Za stáleho miešania var 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne do krémova. Dochuť sójovou omáčkou a medom – japonské kari je jemne sladké.
steps.en: Whisk the roux into a ladleful of the hot broth until smooth so no lumps form, then pour it into the pan. Simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes until the sauce is thick and creamy. Season with the soy sauce and honey – Japanese curry is gently sweet.

steps.sk: Kura je hotové, keď je vnútri biele a mäkké a zemiaky sa dajú ľahko rozpučiť. Podávaj s ryžou. Kari na druhý deň zhustne a chutí ešte lepšie; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni, pri ohrievaní prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: The chicken is done when it is white and tender inside and the potatoes crush easily. Serve with the rice. The curry thickens and tastes even better the next day; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days – add a little water when reheating.

description.sk: Japonské ryžové trojuholníky – praktická desiata do školy aj práce.
description.en: Japanese rice triangles: a handy snack for school or work.

steps.sk: Ryžu daj do misy, zalej studenou vodou, premiešaj rukou a vodu zlej. Opakuj 3- až 4-krát, kým voda nie je takmer číra – zmyješ škrobový prach a ryža bude lepkavá, ale nie mazľavá. Nechaj ju 10 minút odkvapkať v sitku.
steps.en: Put the rice in a bowl, cover with cold water, swirl it with your hand and pour the water off. Repeat 3 to 4 times until the water is almost clear – this washes off the starch dust so the rice is sticky but not gluey. Leave it to drain in a sieve for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: V hrnci zalej ryžu 240 ml vody, priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút. Pokrievku počas varu nedvíhaj.
steps.en: Put the rice in a pan with 240 ml of water, bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes. Do not lift the lid while it cooks.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav a nechaj ryžu 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou, aby dotiahla. Potom ju prelož do misy a nechaj trochu vychladnúť, kým ju udržíš v rukách – má byť teplá, studená by sa nelepila.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and let the rice stand, covered, for 10 minutes to finish. Then tip it into a bowl and let it cool until you can handle it – it should be warm, as cold rice does not stick together.

steps.sk: Plnka: tuniak dôkladne sceď a vidličkou ho rozmiešaj s majonézou a sójovou omáčkou. Nori nastrihaj na prúžky asi 4 × 10 cm. Priprav si misku s vodou a soľ.
steps.en: Filling: drain the tuna thoroughly and mix it with the mayonnaise and soy sauce using a fork. Cut the nori into strips about 4 × 10 cm. Set out a bowl of water and the salt.

steps.sk: Ruky namoč vo vode a potri ich štipkou soli – ryža sa nebude lepiť a onigiri bude jemne slané. Naber asi šestinu ryže, v dlani ju splošti, do stredu daj lyžičku plnky a ryžu okolo nej uzavri. Pevne, no nie nasilu ju stlač do trojuholníka s hranou asi 7 cm a tvaruj ho zo všetkých strán.
steps.en: Wet your hands and rub them with a pinch of salt – the rice will not stick and the onigiri will be lightly salted. Take about a sixth of the rice, flatten it in your palm, put a teaspoon of filling in the centre and close the rice around it. Press it firmly but gently into a triangle with sides of about 7 cm, shaping it on all sides.

steps.sk: Každé onigiri obaľ prúžkom nori okolo spodnej hrany až tesne pred jedlom, aby nori zostala chrumkavá. Onigiri zjedz v ten istý deň. Zabalené vo fólii ich uchovaj v chlade; v chladničke ryža stvrdne, preto ich pred jedlom nechaj chvíľu postáť pri izbovej teplote.
steps.en: Wrap a strip of nori around the base of each onigiri just before eating so it stays crisp. Eat them the same day. Keep them wrapped in cling film somewhere cool; the rice hardens in the fridge, so let them sit at room temperature for a while before eating.

description.sk: Tenké plátky hovädzieho marinované v sladkej sójovej omáčke s hruškou.
description.en: Thin slices of beef marinated in a sweet soy sauce with pear.

steps.sk: Mäso daj na 15 minút do mrazničky, aby stuhlo, a potom ho ostrým nožom nakrájaj naprieč vláknami na čo najtenšie plátky (2–3 mm).
steps.en: Put the beef in the freezer for 15 minutes to firm up, then slice it across the grain with a sharp knife as thinly as possible (2–3 mm).

steps.sk: Marináda: hrušku ošúp a nastrúhaj najemno – jej enzýmy mäso zjemnia. Zmiešaj ju so sójovou omáčkou, cukrom, pretlačeným cesnakom, nastrúhaným zázvorom a sezamovým olejom. Mäso v nej premiešaj a nechaj marinovať aspoň 20 minút (v chladničke aj do druhého dňa).
steps.en: Marinade: peel and finely grate the pear – its enzymes tenderise the meat. Mix it with the soy sauce, sugar, crushed garlic, grated ginger and sesame oil. Toss the beef in it and marinate for at least 20 minutes (or in the fridge until the next day).

steps.sk: Medzitým ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 340 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 340 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké mesiačiky a jarnú cibuľku na kolieska. Veľkú panvicu rozpáľ s olejom na vysokom ohni, kým nezačne dymiť.
steps.en: Slice the onion into thin wedges and the spring onions into rings. Heat a large frying pan with the oil over high heat until smoking.

steps.sk: Mäso aj s cibuľou opekaj v dvoch dávkach, každú 3 až 4 minúty – rozlož ho v tenkej vrstve a prvú minútu ním nehýb. Je hotové, keď okraje skaramelizujú do tmava a marináda sa zmení na lepkavú glazúru. Natlačené mäso by sa varilo vo vlastnej šťave.
steps.en: Cook the beef with the onion in two batches, 3 to 4 minutes each – spread it in a thin layer and leave it for the first minute. It is done when the edges caramelise dark and the marinade turns into a sticky glaze. Crowded meat stews in its own juices.

steps.sk: Posyp jarnou cibuľkou a sezamom a podávaj s ryžou, prípadne s listami šalátu na zabalenie.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the spring onions and sesame seeds and serve with the rice, and lettuce leaves for wrapping if you like.

title.sk: Dan dan rezance s mletým bravčovým
title.en: Dan dan noodles with ground pork

description.sk: Pikantné sečuánske rezance s orieškovou omáčkou.
description.en: Spicy Sichuan noodles with a nutty sauce.

steps.sk: Omáčka: v miske rozmiešaj arašidové maslo s 2 lyžicami sójovej omáčky, octom, cukrom, srirachou a 4 lyžicami horúcej vody, kým nie je hladká a tečie ako hustá smotana. Rozdeľ ju na dno 3 misiek.
steps.en: Sauce: stir the peanut butter with 2 tablespoons of the soy sauce, the vinegar, sugar, sriracha and 4 tablespoons of hot water until smooth and pourable like thick cream. Divide it between the bottoms of 3 bowls.

steps.sk: Cesnak nasekaj, zázvor nastrúhaj a jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na kolieska. Pak choi umy a väčšie kusy pozdĺžne rozpoľ. Postav na sporák veľký hrniec vody na rezance.
steps.en: Chop the garlic, grate the ginger and slice the spring onions. Wash the pak choi and halve the larger heads lengthways. Put a large pan of water on to boil for the noodles.

steps.sk: Vo woku alebo panvici zohrej olej na stredne vysokom ohni a mäso s cesnakom a zázvorom opekaj 6 až 7 minút; varechou ho rozbíjaj na drobné kúsky. Je hotové, keď nie je nikde ružové a začína byť chrumkavé. Pridaj zvyšnú sójovú omáčku a opekaj ešte minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the pork with the garlic and ginger for 6 to 7 minutes, breaking it into small crumbs with a spoon. It is done when no pink remains and it starts to crisp. Add the remaining soy sauce and cook for a minute more.

steps.sk: Rezance uvar podľa návodu na obale; posledné 2 minúty k nim pridaj pak choi. Sceď ich a odlož si pár lyžíc vody z rezancov.
steps.en: Cook the noodles according to the packet, adding the pak choi for the last 2 minutes. Drain, keeping a few spoonfuls of the cooking water.

steps.sk: Do misiek s omáčkou rozdeľ rezance a pak choi, navrch daj mäso a posyp cibuľkou. Pred jedlom všetko dôkladne premiešaj od dna; ak je omáčka hustá, prilej lyžicu vody z rezancov.
steps.en: Divide the noodles and pak choi between the bowls of sauce, top with the pork and sprinkle with the spring onions. Mix everything thoroughly from the bottom before eating; if the sauce is thick, add a spoonful of the noodle water.

description.sk: Chrumkavá uhorka rozbitá valčekom, s cesnakom, octom a sezamom.
description.en: Crunchy cucumber smashed with a rolling pin, with garlic, vinegar and sesame.

steps.sk: Uhorku umy a polož na dosku. Plochou stranou noža alebo valčekom po nej niekoľkokrát udri, kým nepraskne – rozbitá uhorka nasaje dresing lepšie ako krájaná. Potom ju nakrájaj šikmo na kúsky asi 2 cm.
steps.en: Wash the cucumber and lay it on a board. Bash it a few times with the flat of a knife or a rolling pin until it cracks – smashed cucumber soaks up dressing better than sliced. Then cut it on the diagonal into pieces of about 2 cm.

steps.sk: Uhorku daj do sitka, posyp soľou, premiešaj a nechaj 10 minút odkvapkať – soľ z nej vytiahne vodu a uhorka zostane chrumkavá.
steps.en: Put the cucumber in a sieve, sprinkle with the salt, toss and leave to drain for 10 minutes – the salt draws out water and keeps the cucumber crunchy.

steps.sk: Medzitým priprav dresing: cesnak pretlač a zmiešaj ho so sójovou omáčkou, octom, sezamovým olejom, cukrom a čili, kým sa cukor nerozpustí.
steps.en: Meanwhile make the dressing: crush the garlic and mix it with the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and chilli until the sugar dissolves.

steps.sk: Uhorku zľahka vytlač, prelož do misy, zalej dresingom a premiešaj. Posyp sezamom a podávaj hneď, najlepšie ako prílohu k ryži alebo rezancom – časom by pustila vodu.
steps.en: Squeeze the cucumber lightly, tip it into a bowl, pour over the dressing and toss. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve at once, ideally as a side to rice or noodles – it turns watery as it stands.

title.sk: Rýchly ramen s vajíčkom a bravčovým
title.en: Quick ramen with egg and pork

description.sk: Voňavý miso vývar s rezancami, mäsom a vajíčkom so žĺtkom, ktorý tečie, za 30 minút.
description.en: A fragrant miso broth with noodles, pork and a runny-yolk egg in 30 minutes.

steps.sk: V malom hrnci priveď do varu vodu, lyžicou do nej opatrne vlož vajcia priamo z chladničky a var presne 6,5 minúty. Hneď ich prelož do misky s ľadovou vodou – žĺtok zostane krémový – a po vychladnutí ošúp.
steps.en: Bring a small pan of water to the boil, gently lower in the eggs straight from the fridge with a spoon and cook for exactly 6½ minutes. Transfer them at once to a bowl of iced water – the yolks stay jammy – and peel once cool.

steps.sk: Cesnak a zázvor nakrájaj na tenké plátky a šampiňóny na plátky. Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej sezamový olej na strednom ohni a cesnak so zázvorom opekaj pol minúty, kým nezavoňajú.
steps.en: Thinly slice the garlic, ginger and mushrooms. Heat the sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the garlic and ginger for half a minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Prilej 900 ml vody, pridaj rozdrobený bujón, sójovú omáčku a huby a mierne var 10 minút, aby vývar nasal chuť.
steps.en: Pour in 900 ml of water, add the crumbled stock cube, soy sauce and mushrooms and simmer gently for 10 minutes so the broth takes on the flavours.

steps.sk: Medzitým karé nakrájaj na tenké plátky asi 5 mm. Na panvici rozpáľ olej na vysokom ohni a plátky opekaj 2 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a vnútri bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Meanwhile slice the pork loin thinly, about 5 mm. Heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat and fry the slices for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown with no pink inside.

steps.sk: Rezance uvar podľa návodu na obale v samostatnom hrnci vody (vo vývare by ho rezance zakalili škrobom) a sceď. Vývar odstav, miso rozmiešaj v naberačke vývaru a vmiešaj späť – po pridaní misa ho už nevar.
steps.en: Cook the noodles according to the packet in a separate pan of water (in the broth their starch would cloud it) and drain. Take the broth off the heat, dissolve the miso in a ladleful of it and stir it back in – do not boil it once the miso is in.

steps.sk: Rezance rozdeľ do 2 veľkých misiek a zalej horúcim vývarom s hubami. Navrch polož mäso, rozpolené vajcia, jarnú cibuľku a nori a podávaj hneď.
steps.en: Divide the noodles between 2 large bowls and pour over the hot broth with the mushrooms. Top with the pork, halved eggs, spring onions and nori and serve at once.

description.sk: Chrumkavé tofu v lesklej sladkosolenej glazúre – rastlinná večera za pol hodiny.
description.en: Crispy tofu in a glossy sweet-salty glaze: a plant-based dinner in half an hour.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 340 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 340 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Tofu zabaľ do čistej utierky a na 10 minút ho zaťaž doskou a hrncom, aby pustilo vodu. Potom ho nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm a v miske ich obaľ v škrobe, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán pokryté.
steps.en: Wrap the tofu in a clean tea towel and weigh it down with a board and a pan for 10 minutes to press out the water. Then cut it into roughly 2 cm cubes and toss them in a bowl with the cornflour until coated on all sides.

steps.sk: Omáčka: zmiešaj sójovú omáčku, cukor, ocot, nastrúhaný zázvor, pretlačený cesnak a 3 lyžice vody. Brokolicu rozober na ružičky, var ju 3 minúty vo vriacej vode a sceď.
steps.en: Sauce: mix the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, grated ginger, crushed garlic and 3 tablespoons of water. Cut the broccoli into florets, cook them in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.

steps.sk: V širokej nepriľnavej panvici rozohrej olej na stredne vysokom ohni a tofu opekaj asi 8 minút; každé 2 minúty kocky obráť, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatisté a chrumkavé. Panvicu nepreplň – kocky sa nemajú dotýkať.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for about 8 minutes, turning the cubes every 2 minutes, until golden and crisp on all sides. Do not overcrowd the pan – the cubes should not touch.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň, vlej omáčku a jemne miešaj asi minútu, kým nezhustne do lepkavej glazúry, ktorá obalí tofu. Dlhším varením by obal zmäkol.
steps.en: Lower the heat, pour in the sauce and stir gently for about a minute until it thickens into a sticky glaze that coats the tofu. Cooking it longer makes the coating soft.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a brokolicou, posypané sezamom. Na meal prep ulož tofu s ryžou a brokolicou do krabičiek; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni, tofu však stratí chrumkavosť.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and broccoli, sprinkled with sesame seeds. For meal prep, pack the tofu with the rice and broccoli in containers; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days, though the tofu loses its crunch.

title.sk: Oyakodon – ryža s kuracím mäsom a vajíčkom
title.en: Oyakodon: chicken and egg rice bowl

description.sk: Japonské domáce jedlo z jednej panvice: kura a vajce v sladkosolenom vývare na ryži.
description.en: Japanese home cooking from one pan: chicken and egg in a sweet-salty broth over rice.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je číra, a v hrnci ju zalej 225 ml vody. Priveď do varu, prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 12 minút; potom ju nechaj 10 minút postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear and put it in a pan with 225 ml of water. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes; then let it stand, covered, for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké pásiky, kuracie stehná na kúsky asi 2 cm a jarnú cibuľku na kolieska. Vajcia rozbi do misky a len zľahka ich premiešaj vidličkou – bielky a žĺtky majú zostať čiastočne oddelené.
steps.en: Slice the onion into thin strips, cut the chicken thighs into roughly 2 cm pieces and slice the spring onions. Crack the eggs into a bowl and mix them only lightly with a fork – the whites and yolks should stay partly separate.

steps.sk: V malej panvici (asi 20 cm) zmiešaj 150 ml vody, rozdrobený bujón, sójovú omáčku a cukor a priveď do varu. Pridaj cibuľu a var 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne.
steps.en: In a small frying pan (about 20 cm) combine 150 ml of water, the crumbled stock cube, soy sauce and sugar and bring to the boil. Add the onion and simmer for 3 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso v jednej vrstve a mierne var 6 minút, raz ho obráť, kým nie je vnútri biele, bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Add the chicken in a single layer and simmer gently for 6 minutes, turning once, until white inside with no pink.

steps.sk: Vajcia vlej krúživým pohybom na mäso, panvicu prikry a var na miernom ohni 1 až 2 minúty, kým nie sú polostuhnuté – vrch má byť ešte krémový. Prevarené vajce by bolo gumové.
steps.en: Pour the eggs over the chicken in a circle, cover the pan and cook over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes until half set – the top should still be creamy. Overcooked egg turns rubbery.

steps.sk: Ryžu rozdeľ do 2 misiek. Na každú nechaj zošmyknúť polovicu obsahu panvice aj so šťavou, posyp jarnou cibuľkou a podávaj hneď.
steps.en: Divide the rice between 2 bowls. Slide half the contents of the pan with its juices onto each, sprinkle with the spring onions and serve at once.

title.sk: Japchae – kórejské rezance so zeleninou a hovädzím
title.en: Japchae: Korean noodles with vegetables and beef

description.sk: Lesklé rezance so sezamom, farebnou zeleninou a prúžkami mäsa.
description.en: Glossy noodles with sesame, colourful vegetables and strips of beef.

steps.sk: Rezance priprav podľa návodu na obale, sceď, prepláchni studenou vodou a premiešaj s lyžicou sezamového oleja, aby sa nezlepili. Dlhé rezance nožnicami raz-dvakrát prestrihni.
steps.en: Cook the noodles according to the packet, drain, rinse under cold water and toss with 1 tablespoon of the sesame oil so they do not stick. Snip long noodles once or twice with scissors.

steps.sk: Omáčka: zmiešaj sójovú omáčku, cukor, pretlačený cesnak a zvyšný sezamový olej, kým sa cukor nerozpustí.
steps.en: Sauce: mix the soy sauce, sugar, crushed garlic and remaining sesame oil until the sugar dissolves.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj naprieč vláknami na tenké prúžky a premiešaj s lyžicou omáčky. Mrkvu, cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na tenké prúžky a šampiňóny na plátky.
steps.en: Cut the beef across the grain into thin strips and toss with a spoonful of the sauce. Cut the carrot, onion and pepper into thin strips and slice the mushrooms.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej panvici rozpáľ trochu oleja na vysokom ohni a mäso opekaj 3 minúty, kým nie je opečené a prepečené. Odlož ho do veľkej misy.
steps.en: Heat a little oil in a large frying pan over high heat and stir-fry the beef for 3 minutes until browned and cooked through. Tip it into a large bowl.

steps.sk: V tej istej panvici postupne opeč na troche oleja mrkvu, cibuľu, papriku a huby – každú zeleninu zvlášť 2 až 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne, ale zostane chrumkavá – a pridávaj ich do misy. Nakoniec v panvici asi minútu nechaj zavädnúť špenát.
steps.en: In the same pan cook the carrot, onion, pepper and mushrooms one after another in a little oil – each for 2 to 3 minutes until softened but still crisp – adding them to the bowl as you go. Finally wilt the spinach in the pan for about a minute.

steps.sk: Do misy pridaj rezance a zvyšnú omáčku a rukami alebo kliešťami všetko dôkladne premiešaj. Ochutnaj, posyp sezamom a podávaj. Japchae chutí teplé aj studené a v chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Add the noodles and the remaining sauce to the bowl and mix everything thoroughly with your hands or tongs. Taste, sprinkle with the sesame seeds and serve. Japchae is good warm or cold and keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Pajeon – kórejská placka s jarnou cibuľkou

description.sk: Chrumkavá placka s dipom zo sójovej omáčky a octu.
description.en: A crispy pancake with a soy and vinegar dip.

steps.sk: V mise vymiešaj múku, škrob, vajce, soľ a 180 ml ľadovo studenej vody na riedke cesto ako na palacinky. Nemiešaj dlho – pár hrudiek nevadí; studená voda a krátke miešanie spravia placku chrumkavou.
steps.en: In a bowl mix the flour, cornflour, egg, salt and 180 ml of ice-cold water into a thin, pancake-like batter. Do not overmix – a few lumps are fine; cold water and brief mixing make the pancake crisp.

steps.sk: Jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na kúsky dlhé asi 5 cm (hrubšie pozdĺžne rozpoľ) a cuketu na tenké prúžky. Vmiešaj ich do cesta – zeleniny má byť viac ako cesta.
steps.en: Cut the spring onions into lengths of about 5 cm (halve thick ones lengthways) and the courgette into thin strips. Stir them into the batter – there should be more vegetables than batter.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej nepriľnavej panvici rozpáľ polovicu oleja na stredne vysokom ohni. Vlej polovicu cesta a rozotri ho na tenkú placku, aby zelenina ležala v jednej vrstve. Peč 4 minúty, kým okraje nie sú zlatohnedé a chrumkavé.
steps.en: Heat half the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Pour in half the batter and spread it into a thin pancake so the vegetables lie in a single layer. Cook for 4 minutes until the edges are golden brown and crisp.

steps.sk: Placku obráť (pomôž si tanierom), pritlač ju obracačkou a peč ďalšie 3 minúty do chrumkava. Ak sa zdá suchá, prilej po okraji trochu oleja. Opakuj so zvyšným olejom a cestom.
steps.en: Flip the pancake (a plate helps), press it down with a spatula and cook for another 3 minutes until crisp. If it looks dry, drizzle a little oil around the edge. Repeat with the remaining oil and batter.

steps.sk: Dip: zmiešaj sójovú omáčku, ocot a čili. Placku nakrájaj na štvorce alebo trojuholníky a podávaj hneď, kým je chrumkavá, s dipom na namáčanie.
steps.en: Dip: mix the soy sauce, vinegar and chilli. Cut the pancake into squares or triangles and serve at once while crisp, with the dip.
